SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Whoa, this is a five-blade razor? These things are intense!

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se você usa um barbeador de 5 lâminas, isso quer dizer que...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, I just asked you to organize it—not inspect everything!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我只说了帮我整理吧？就整理而已！

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why are you even looking at that...?

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa juga kamu ngeliatin itu sih...?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Even I don’t use a five-blade... wow.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哇，我自己都不用五层刀片的呢...
